body:
SKETCH S3 v1 is posted on TASK-1945 (the latest comment). Please review it for signoff.

It is the last slice, split into two PRs: S3a (the report-only ship-ready verdict with a once-only advisor wake via mail plus an actionable event, with C2 carry-over through a quiet CarryOverSite, C3 ready-after-update-branch, and a new SHA-keyed CI reader) and S3b (the request-changes author findings mail and a durable round-cap wake, neither of which exists today).

Three questions: Q1 CI success as every check on the SHA vs only required checks; Q2 no wake for a held PR; Q3 whether extracting a pure approval_decision from the pr ship approval gate counts as gate code.

No production code until signoff. Branch claude/task-1945-s3 is cut from origin/main e33fec11d9.
subject: SKETCH posted (TASK-1945 S3)
